title: BRO Soil Trench Investigation (SFR / Wandonderzoek)
description:
2,806 soil-profile pit/trench investigations (wandonderzoek, SFR) from the Dutch Key Registry of the Subsurface (BRO). Each point is a described soil face used for soil mapping, agriculture and nature management. Produced under VRO; bronhouder TNO.

🤖 AI/Agent users: see AGENTS.md for field descriptions, query examples and usage tips.

table:columns.name: bro_id
table:columns.description: BRO registration ID — unique identifier of the object in the Basisregistratie Ondergrond.

table:columns.name: quality_regime
table:columns.description: BRO quality regime: IMBRO (full assurance) or IMBRO/A (transitional/lower assurance).

table:columns.name: delivery_accountable_party
table:columns.description: KvK number of the party accountable for delivery (bronhouder).

table:columns.name: delivery_context
table:columns.description: Legal/administrative framework under which the object was registered.

table:columns.name: survey_purpose
table:columns.description: Purpose of the survey (e.g. national soil map unit, nature soil build-up).

table:columns.name: research_report_date
table:columns.description: Date the research report was registered (YYYY-MM-DD, free text).

table:columns.name: litter_layer_investigated
table:columns.description: Whether the litter layer was investigated (ja/nee).

table:columns.name: applied_transformation
table:columns.description: Whether a coordinate/height transformation was applied (ja/nee).

table:columns.name: standardized_location
table:columns.description: Object location — WKB geometry in EPSG:4258 (ETRS89).

table:columns.name: standardized_location_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float, ymin: float, xmax: float, ymax: float>
table:columns.description: Per-feature bounding box struct (xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax) for spatial filtering.
